chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Azraq, from Abd al-Rahman, from Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
I asked him about a man who divorces his wife with the final divorce (talaq al-khulas or talaq al-mughallazah), he said: Yes, they inherit from each other during the waiting period (iddah).
ai.seo_question: Do husband and wife inherit from each other after a final divorce?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam Musa al-Kadhim clarifies that the final, irrevocable divorce (Talaq al-Bain) does not sever the inheritance bond during the waiting period (Iddah), a ruling derived from the principle that the marital link persists until the completion of the period. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the 'finality' of such a divorce primarily concerns the right of return without a new contract, rather than the immediate dissolution of all legal ties like inheritance. The ruling underscores the continuity of marital rights during the transitional phase of Iddah, even in cases of definitive separation.
